rubrics.justification: Accurately describes an expanded blastocyst with thin zona, visible ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with 3AA; appropriately notes image clarity limits. Minor overinterpretation of the adjacent floating structure reduces precision.
Strongly integrates age, tubal factor diagnosis, prior live birth, ovarian response, sperm quality, endometrial thickness, BMI, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with conclusions generally supported by the case data. Slight overconfidence in linking morphology to likely euploidy and a somewhat optimistic implantation estimate prevent a top score.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including SET for a good-prognosis patient and standard luteal support. Minor deviations include overemphasis on ERA/PGT-A after failure and strong claims about prognosis from morphology alone.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, and lifestyle advice. Useful overall, though some future-cycle suggestions are somewhat generic rather than tightly tailored.
